response.overview: The story of Ronnie and Sneha who are unrelated to each other but see a same dream. They go to an oneirologist named Jai who is intrigued by this unique case where 2 unknown persons see a same dream. Jai decides to unravel the mystery and the meaning behind their dream.
response.tagline: The scientific study of dreams. The focus is to study them as personal experience to interpret meaning behind.
response.title: The Dream
